name: calendar
title: Calendar
summary: A month grid to pick a date, several dates or a range.
description: A month grid to pick a date, several dates or a range, shown inline. A header with the pager's previous and next buttons around the month, which switches to a month and then a year view; seven columns of days, six weeks so the grid never changes height. The selected date is filled with ink, the hovered one takes the hover colour, today carries a dot. Arrow keys, Page Up / Down, Home and End move through the days at once. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag date-picker machine, through Ark UI. The date picker shows the same views in its popup.

anatomy.description: The engine's root, inline. data-disabled at half opacity.
The engine's content element: role=application, named by the caller's aria-label; it holds the views (the engine finds the focused date inside it). In the date picker, its popup is this element.
One per view (day, month, year); the engine hides all but the current one. 224px wide (280px on coarse pointers), the same size in every view and every month.
prev · title · next, spread across the view (the pager's between layout).

The real Button (ghost, sm, square, muted), marked data-calendar="prev", with a Tooltip and an aria-label naming what it pages (Previous month / year / decade). Disabled by the engine past min. The caret mirrors right-to-left.

A ghost sm Button, marked data-calendar="title": the month and year (day view), the year (month view), the decade (year view), xs medium ink. Switches to the next view up; disabled in the year view, where it reads as plain text.
role=grid labelled with the visible month; keyboard handling lives here. Months and years fill the day grid's height (216px, 264px on coarse pointers).
aria-hidden (every date's label says its weekday).
Short weekday name in the locale: 2xs, ink-2, 24px high.

role=gridcell, aria-selected, aria-current=date on today. Carries the range band (color.hover-2), rounded at the range's ends and at the ends of each week; color.hover while the second end is being chosen.

role=button, the date (or month, or year): 32px square, 40px on coarse pointers; a 40px-high full-width row in the month and year views. data-selected: ink fill, on-ink text, weight 500. data-today: a 4px dot under the number. data-outside-range (the other month's days): ink-3, not selectable. data-unavailable: ink-3, struck through. Hover: color.hover.

value.description: Selected dates as ISO strings ("2025-03-12"). single: one; range: the start and the end.

min.description: Earliest date that can be chosen (ISO). Paging stops at its month.

max.description: Latest date that can be chosen (ISO).

unavailable.description: Dates that cannot be chosen (ISO). Also takes isDateUnavailable(date).

defaultFocusedValue.description: The date the calendar opens on when no value is set (its month is shown; the keyboard starts there). Without it: today.

startOfWeek.description: 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. Without it: the locale's.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag for the names and digits. Without it: the LocaleProvider's.

timeZone.description: Where "today" is taken. Without it: the browser's.

fixedWeeks.description: Always six weeks, so the grid keeps its height from month to month.

keyboard: Tab reaches previous, the title, next, then the focused date of the grid (one tab stop)
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move one day (swapped right-to-left), ArrowUp / ArrowDown one week; past the edge the month changes
Page Up / Page Down move one month (Shift: one year); in the month and year views, one year and one decade
Home / End move to the first and the last day of the month (the first and last month or year in the other views)
Enter / Space choose the focused date; in the month and year views they open that month or year
Every move is instant: the focus ring jumps, nothing slides. The ring is drawn inside the date (the dates touch), never over its neighbour
notes: Give the calendar an aria-label. Each date is labelled with its full date and its state (Selected date, In range, Not available); the grid with the visible month.
Today is marked by a dot and aria-current="date", not by colour alone; selected dates by an ink fill and aria-selected.
The previous and next buttons have tooltips and aria-labels naming the step; the title's name is its visible text.

motion: dates: hover and selection colour over duration.fast; instant from the keyboard (kbd-instant)
range band: the cell's colour changes with the dates it holds, over duration.fast; instant from the keyboard
press: a date scales by motion.press-scale over duration.press, from the pointer only
paging, switching views, moving focus: instant; nothing slides or fades
header buttons: the Button's own hover and press
